name: erichlof/THREE.js-PathTracing-Renderer
description: Real-time path tracing with global illumination and progressive rendering running entirely in the browser via Three.js and WebGL, achieving 30-60 FPS on consumer hardware. Extensive collection of interactive demos.
score_rationale: 2.2k-star browser-based path tracer that makes ray tracing accessible without native code, with rich demo library and active maintenance.
summary: Browser-based path tracer with global illumination running in WebGL at 30-60 FPS.
